title: Reconnect
description: Hosters that limit free downloads do so per address. When downloads are stuck behind such a limit, a script you write can ask the router for a new one.
enabled_description: Only while free downloads are waiting on an address limit, never on its own account.
script_description: A file in the post-processing scripts directory. It runs in the same sandbox.
interval_description: Reconnecting in a loop against a hoster that is simply refusing gains nothing.
timeout_description: Covers the script and the wait for the address to change.
checks_description: One address per line, asked in order. Leave empty for the built-in list. These requests leave the machine.
abort_description: Off, a reconnect waits until nothing is transferring. On, transfers are paused and resumed around it.
windows_description: Leave empty to allow any time.
blocked_hosts: Hosters waiting on an address limit

phase.waiting_for_address: Waiting for the address to change
